issues.problem: explain claimed a real negative always changes the word, which is false after nouns and na-adjectives (静かじゃない can be either the negative or the particle); the most important ambiguity was missing
issues.action: Rewrote paragraph 2: the shape tells them apart only after verbs and i-adjectives; after nouns and na-adjectives context and tone decide. Trimmed paragraph 1 to stay under 900 characters

issues.problem: rule said 'after a plain form', but the plain form of a noun includes だ, which contradicts the no-だ rule
issues.action: Rule now reads 'after a plain form (a noun without だ)'

issues.problem: the mistake 明日は休みって marked as wrong is heard in casual speech; it is less standard, not clearly wrong
issues.action: Deleted that mistake entry and kept the polite-register one

issues.problem: explain said that 休みって without だ sounds like the start of a topic, which overstates the rule
issues.action: Removed the sentence; kept 'nouns and na-adjectives keep だ'

issues.problem: 少なくとも was described as とも 'after a counter or number word', which it is not
issues.action: Reworded: 'the とも of 二人とも (both of them) or 少なくとも (at least), which is a different word'

issues.problem: one sa-final example (昨日さ、…) showed the mid-sentence filler さ, not the sentence-final function the skill teaches
issues.action: Replaced it with 心配ないよ。すぐ慣れるさ。 / Don't worry. You'll soon get used to it.
